{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2, so safe to drop)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
grouped = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Extract and print each mean value with full precision
adelie_mean = grouped['Adelie']
chinstrap_mean = grouped['Chinstrap']
gentoo_mean = grouped['Gentoo']

# Print each value exactly as computed
print(adelie_mean)
print(chinstrap_mean)
print(gentoo_mean)

# Identify the species with the highest mean
highest_species = grouped.idxmax()
highest_mean = grouped.max()

# Print the final result
print(highest_species)
print(highest_mean)"}
